title: Pemdi Aceh Tengah
tagline: Kokpit pemdi & dasbor transparansi untuk kabupaten di dataran tinggi Gayo.
problem: Informasi layanan publik kabupaten tersebar di banyak tempat dan sulit dijangkau warga — portal resmi membutuhkan infrastruktur berbayar dan alur konten yang berat untuk dioperasikan satu orang. September 2026, kebutuhan berubah lagi: pengelolaan 250 butir bukti dukung SPBE menjadi prioritas, sementara transparansi publik tetap harus terlayani.

approach.title: Static-first, deploy gratis
approach.text: Seluruh halaman dirender statis lalu di-host di Vercel — biaya nol, waktu muat cepat, dan tahan lonjakan trafik saat momen layanan ramai (penerimaan, cut bersama).

approach.title: Konten terstruktur in-repo
approach.text: Konten hidup sebagai berkas dalam repositori — perubahan lewat git, terlacak siapa mengubah apa, bisa dikoreksi siapa saja lewat pull request.

approach.title: Reposisi Opsi B (Sep 2026)
approach.text: Arah produk digeser terbuka: kokpit pemdi internal untuk mengelola 250 butir bukti dukung, dasbor transparansi publik, dan komponen yang siap terintegrasi ke Alpukat Gayo — infrastruktur lama dipertahankan, bukan dibangun ulang.

outcome: Pivot yang terdokumentasi di depan umum: kebutuhan nyata pemda didahulukan tanpa membuang fondasi yang sudah terbukti — pola "reposisi tanpa membangun ulang dari nol" yang bisa direplikasi pemerintah daerah lain.

en.tagline: A government cockpit & transparency dashboard for a highland Gayo regency.
en.problem: Public service information was scattered and hard for residents to reach, and an official portal would require paid infrastructure and a heavy workflow for a one-person team. By September 2026 the need shifted again: managing 250 SPBE supporting-evidence items became the priority, while public transparency still had to be served.

approach.title: Static-first, free deploys
approach.text: Every page is rendered statically and hosted on Vercel — zero cost, fast loads, and resilient to traffic spikes during busy service seasons.

approach.title: Structured content in-repo
approach.text: Content lives as files in the repository — changes go through git, tracked and correctable by anyone via pull request.

approach.title: Repositioning, option B (Sep 2026)
approach.text: The product direction shifted in the open: an internal government cockpit managing 250 supporting-evidence items, a public transparency dashboard, and components ready to integrate into Alpukat Gayo — the existing foundation is kept, not rebuilt.

en.outcome: A pivot documented in public: real government needs come first without throwing away a proven foundation — a "reposition without rebuilding from scratch" pattern other regions can replicate.

title: Flame ADE
tagline: Emulator terminal AI-native ~7 MB — Tauri 2 + Rust + React 19.
problem: Terminal modern dengan AI biasanya membawa Electron (ratusan MB) dan mengunci pengguna ke satu penyedia model. Pengguna menginginkan terminal yang punya "otak" tapi tetap ringan, cepat, dan tidak memaksa langganan.

approach.title: Tauri, bukan Electron
approach.text: Shell desktop ditulis Rust dengan WebView sistem — hasilnya binary ±7 MB dan konsumsi memori orde lebih kecil dibanding Electron.

approach.title: AI sebagai fitur, bukan kandungan
approach.text: Bring-your-own-key: pengguna menempel kunci model pilihannya (lokal atau cloud) — terminal tidak pernah mengirim data ke server siapa pun selain milik pengguna sendiri.

approach.title: UI React 19 di atas core Rust
approach.text: Pengalaman antarmuka modern (React 19 + TypeScript) tanpa mengorbankan kecepatan proses inti yang tetap di sisi Rust.

outcome: Terminal AI-native yang benar-benar seukuran notepad — target utama macOS Tahoe, dengan disiplin ukuran yang dijaga sejak commit pertama. Bukti bahwa "AI di mana-mana" tidak harus berarti "berat di mana-mana".

en.tagline: An AI-native terminal emulator ~7 MB — Tauri 2 + Rust + React 19.
en.problem: Modern AI terminals usually ship Electron (hundreds of MB) and lock users to a single model provider. People want a terminal with a "brain" that stays light, fast, and free of forced subscriptions.

approach.title: Tauri, not Electron
approach.text: The desktop shell is written in Rust with the system WebView — resulting in a ±7 MB binary and an order of magnitude lower memory use than Electron.

approach.title: AI as a feature, not baggage
approach.text: Bring-your-own-key: users plug in the model key of their choice (local or cloud) — the terminal never sends data to anyone's server but their own.

approach.title: React 19 UI over a Rust core
approach.text: A modern interface experience (React 19 + TypeScript) without sacrificing the speed of core processes that stay on the Rust side.

en.outcome: An AI-native terminal genuinely the size of a text file — primarily targeting macOS Tahoe, with size discipline enforced since the first commit. Proof that "AI everywhere" doesn't have to mean "heavy everywhere".

title: AI First OS
tagline: Arch Linux ISO builder dengan Hermes Agent sebagai warga kelas satu.
problem: Distribusi Linux umum memperlakukan AI sebagai aplikasi tambahan yang dipasang belakangan. Bagaimana jika OS dibangun dari ISO dengan agen AI sebagai "warga negara kelas satu" — tersedia sejak boot pertama, bukan setelah setup manual berjam-jam?

approach.title: ISO builder ter-skrip penuh
approach.text: Seluruh proses build ISO ditulis dalam skrip shell yang bisa diaudit — tidak ada sihir GUI; hasil build reproducible dan bisa dijalankan CI.

approach.title: Hermes sejak boot
approach.text: Agen Hermes terintegrasi pada tahap image — pengguna langsung punya asisten sistem yang memahami konfigurasi mesinnya sendiri.

approach.title: Ekosistem terorkestrasi
approach.text: Terhubung dengan repo orchestration (AGENTS.md, backlog, pipeline kematangan v4) sehingga evolusi OS, dotfiles, dan tooling berjalan di satu alur kerja.

outcome: Eksperimen sistem operasi AI-first yang reproducible: satu perintah build ISO, agen aktif sejak boot, dan seluruh keputusan arsitektur terdokumentasi terbuka untuk ditelusuri siapa saja.

en.tagline: An Arch Linux ISO builder with Hermes Agent as a first-class citizen.
en.problem: Mainstream Linux distributions treat AI as an afterthought app installed later. What if an OS were built from the ISO up with an AI agent as a "first-class citizen" — available from first boot, not after hours of manual setup?

approach.title: Fully scripted ISO builder
approach.text: The entire ISO build process is written in auditable shell scripts — no GUI magic; builds are reproducible and CI-runnable.

approach.title: Hermes from boot
approach.text: The Hermes agent is integrated at the image stage — users immediately get a system assistant that understands its own machine's configuration.

approach.title: An orchestrated ecosystem
approach.text: Connected to the orchestration repo (AGENTS.md, backlog, v4 maturity pipeline) so the OS, dotfiles, and tooling evolve in one workflow.

en.outcome: A reproducible AI-first OS experiment: one command builds the ISO, the agent is active from boot, and every architectural decision is documented in the open for anyone to trace.

title: Niu Gayo Agro-Climate
tagline: Cuaca presisi untuk kopi Arabika Gayo & mitigasi bencana Aceh Tengah.
problem: Dataran Tinggi Gayo adalah produsen kopi Arabika organik terbesar di Indonesia, tetapi variabilitas iklim mikro dan topografi pegunungan terjal membuat prakiraan cuaca umum tidak cukup: petani perlu panduan melawan karat daun (Hemileia vastatrix), menjemur gabah/green bean dengan presisi radiasi matahari, dan warga perlu peringatan dini longsor lereng perkebunan serta luapan Danau Lut Tawar.

approach.title: Data engine meteorologi resolusi tinggi
approach.text: Integrasi stream meteorologi resolusi tinggi ECMWF / WeatherNext 3 — bukan prakiraan generik, melainkan resolusi spasial yang menangkap iklim mikro pegunungan Gayo.

approach.title: Tiga domain panduan nyata
approach.text: Dari kebun (produktivitas & kualitas specialty coffee) ke pascapanen (penjemuran presisi) hingga keselamatan warga (mitigasi hidrometeorologi) — satu sistem, tiga keputusan yang dibantu.

approach.title: Ringan & teruji
approach.text: React 19 + Vite 6 + Tailwind dengan pengujian native Node runner — proyek cepat dirilis tetap terkawal kualitasnya.

outcome: Sistem informasi cuaca presisi yang menyasar rantai nilai kopi Gayo dari kebun sampai penjemuran, plus lapisan mitigasi bencana untuk warga dataran tinggi — civic tech yang berangkat dari kebutuhan lokal yang sangat spesifik.

en.tagline: Precision weather for Gayo Arabica coffee & disaster mitigation in Aceh Tengah.
en.problem: The Gayo Highlands are Indonesia’s largest organic Arabica coffee producer, yet micro-climate variability and steep mountain terrain make generic forecasts insufficient: farmers need guidance against leaf rust (Hemileia vastatrix), precise solar-radiation timing for drying green beans, and residents need early warning for landslides on plantation slopes and Lake Lut Tawar flooding.

approach.title: High-resolution meteorological data engine
approach.text: Integrates high-resolution ECMWF / WeatherNext 3 streams — not generic forecasts, but spatial resolution that captures the Gayo highlands’ micro-climate.

approach.title: Three real guidance domains
approach.text: From the farm (specialty-coffee productivity and quality) to post-harvest (precision drying) to public safety (hydrometeorological mitigation) — one system supporting three decisions.

approach.title: Light & tested
approach.text: React 19 + Vite 6 + Tailwind with the native Node test runner — fast to ship, still quality-controlled.

en.outcome: A precision weather information system covering the Gayo coffee value chain from farm to drying, plus a disaster-mitigation layer for highland residents — civic tech born from very specific local needs.

title: KMS SPBE
tagline: Rumah pengetahuan instansi — dokumen pemerintah yang akhirnya bisa dicari, bukan ditumpuk.
problem: Pengetahuan instansi — kebijakan, SOP, dokumen teknis — biasanya hidup di drive personal dan lampiran email: sulit dicari, versinya tak jelas, dan ikut hilang saat pegawai rotasi. Implementasi SPBE menuntut pengetahuan yang terkelola, bukan sekadar terkumpul.

approach.title: Dokumen yang punya riwayat
approach.text: Manajemen dokumen dengan version control bawaan — siapa mengubah apa selalu kelihatan, bukan 'final_final_v3.xlsx'.

approach.title: Cari cepat, akses berjenjang
approach.text: Smart search lintas dokumen plus role-based access control: setiap peran hanya melihat apa yang seharusnya.

approach.title: Tanpa beban server
approach.text: Next.js + Supabase + Vercel — instansi tidak perlu merawat VM atau basis data fisik apa pun untuk mulai.

outcome: Platform KM siap pakai untuk mendukung implementasi SPBE di instansi pemerintah: 5 modul inti (dokumen, pencarian, akses, versi, kolaborasi tim), lisensi MIT, dan demo yang bisa dicoba langsung.

en.tagline: An institution's knowledge home — government documents that can finally be searched, not stacked.
en.problem: Institutional knowledge — policies, SOPs, technical docs — usually lives in personal drives and email attachments: hard to search, versioned by chaos, and lost with every staff rotation. SPBE implementation demands managed knowledge, not just collected knowledge.

approach.title: Documents with a history
approach.text: Document management with built-in version control — who changed what is always visible, no more 'final_final_v3.xlsx'.

approach.title: Fast search, tiered access
approach.text: Smart search across documents plus role-based access control: each role sees exactly what it should.

approach.title: Zero server burden
approach.text: Next.js + Supabase + Vercel — no VMs or physical databases for an agency to maintain.

en.outcome: A production-ready KM platform for Indonesian government SPBE programs: 5 core modules (documents, search, access, versioning, team collaboration), MIT-licensed, with a live demo.

title: SAPA Smart AI
tagline: Asisten data statistik Aceh Tengah — tanya dalam bahasa Indonesia, dijawab lengkap dengan buktinya.
problem: Data statistik kabupaten terkunci di tabel-tabel SPLP yang harus dibaca manual. Warga dan pimpinan bertanya dalam bahasa sehari-hari — jawabannya tersebar di banyak tabel, dan tak ada cara memastikan angka yang keluar bisa dipertanggungjawabkan.

approach.title: Satu sumber kebenaran
approach.text: Semua jawaban ditarik langsung dari satu sumber: API SPLP. Tanpa basis data tiruan, tanpa angka karangan model.

approach.title: Jawaban berbukti
approach.text: Setiap jawaban menyertakan indikator, nilai, satuan, tahun, dan OPD asalnya — pengguna bisa menelusuri dari mana angka itu datang.

approach.title: Arsitektur minimal, serah terima maksimal
approach.text: Tanpa akun pengguna, tanpa cron, tanpa gudang data — cache 10 menit lalu buang. Disertai 10+ dokumen serah terima: berita acara, arsitektur, runbook, hingga rencana pemeliharaan.

outcome: Berjalan di tahap awal produksi untuk Dinas Kominfo Kabupaten Aceh Tengah. Saat langganan model bahasa tertunda, layanan tanya-jawab sengaja dimatikan lewat panel admin — dashboard, GIS, dan laporan tetap hidup. Degradasi yang jujur dan terdokumentasi.

en.tagline: An Aceh Tengah statistics assistant — ask in Indonesian, get answers with the receipts attached.
en.problem: Regency statistics were locked inside SPLP tables that had to be read manually. Citizens and leadership ask questions in everyday language — answers were scattered across tables, with no way to verify where a number came from.

approach.title: One source of truth
approach.text: Every answer is pulled live from a single source: the SPLP API. No shadow database, no numbers the model invented.

approach.title: Answers with evidence
approach.text: Each answer carries the indicator, value, unit, year, and originating agency — users can trace exactly where the number came from.

approach.title: Minimal architecture, maximal handover
approach.text: No user accounts, no cron, no data warehouse — a 10-minute cache and nothing else. Shipped with 10+ handover documents: minutes, architecture, runbooks, and a maintenance plan.

en.outcome: Running in early production for the Aceh Tengah Regency ICT Office. When the language-model subscription lapsed, the Q&A service was deliberately switched off from the admin panel — dashboard, GIS, and reports stayed up. Honest, documented degradation.

title: Didong-Code
tagline: Lingkungan pengembangan agentic di desktop — dengan jiwa seni Didong Gayo.
problem: AI coding agent hampir selalu hidup di terminal — cepat bagi engineer, tapi tinggi tembok masuknya bagi orang lain. Dan nyaris semuanya berpenampilan seragam: gelap, dingin, tanpa akar.

approach.title: Desktop, bukan terminal
approach.text: Electron + React: agen AI coding dengan antarmuka desktop yang familiar — jendela, menu, dan alur yang bisa dipelajari tanpa hafal command.

approach.title: Agentic end-to-end
approach.text: Dibangun sebagai agentic development environment: agen yang mengerti konteks proyek, bukan sekadar autocomplete.

approach.title: Identitas dari Gayo
approach.text: Nama dan semangat Didong — seni sastra lisan Gayo Aceh — menjadi bagian dari produk, bukan tempelan marketing.

outcome: Aplikasi desktop lintas platform (Windows/macOS/Linux) yang membawa budaya Gayo ke tooling developer global — eksperimen serius soal identitas lokal di perangkat lunak internasional.

en.tagline: An agentic development environment for the desktop — with the soul of Gayo Didong art.
en.problem: AI coding agents almost always live in the terminal — fast for engineers, but a steep wall for everyone else. And nearly all of them look identical: dark, cold, rootless.

approach.title: Desktop, not terminal
approach.text: Electron + React: an AI coding agent with a familiar desktop interface — windows, menus, and flows you can learn without memorizing commands.

approach.title: Agentic end-to-end
approach.text: Built as a full agentic development environment: an agent that understands project context, not just autocomplete.

approach.title: Identity from Gayo
approach.text: The name and spirit of Didong — the oral literary art of the Gayo people of Aceh — is part of the product, not a marketing sticker.

en.outcome: A cross-platform desktop app (Windows/macOS/Linux) carrying Gayo culture into global developer tooling — a serious experiment in local identity for international software.

title: Niu-LKH
tagline: Laporan kegiatan harian yang nggak bikin malas — foto bukti terkompresi otomatis, PDF tinggal klik.
problem: Pencatatan laporan kegiatan harian pegawai biasanya manual: kumpul foto, ketik ulang, rekap ulang tiap minggu. Berulang, rawan hilang, dan bukti dukung tersebar di galeri ponsel.

approach.title: Satu form, satu layar
approach.text: Tanggal, uraian, tempat, penjab, dasar surat, output — plus upload bukti dukung yang dikompresi otomatis di browser, biar hemat dan tetap terbaca.

approach.title: Data di tangan sendiri
approach.text: Penyimpanan lokal (localStorage) tanpa server dan tanpa akun — dengan sinkronisasi otomatis opsional ke Google Sheets untuk rekap bersama.

approach.title: Ekspor siap tanda tangan
approach.text: PDF lengkap dengan foto bukti, atau Excel/CSV untuk diolah lagi. Dashboard, kalender, dan statistik harian menyusul dari data yang sama.

outcome: Aplikasi ringan bertema HUD gaming yang dipakai harian: satu sumber data, tiga format ekspor, nol server. Di hosting GitHub Pages dengan React 19 + Vite + Tailwind 4.

en.tagline: Daily activity reports that don't drain you — evidence photos auto-compressed, PDFs one click away.
en.problem: Daily staff activity reporting is usually manual: collect photos, retype everything, redo the recap weekly. Repetitive, loss-prone, and evidence scattered across phone galleries.

approach.title: One form, one screen
approach.text: Date, description, place, official, decree, output — plus evidence uploads auto-compressed in the browser to stay light and readable.

approach.title: Data in your own hands
approach.text: Local storage (localStorage) with no server and no accounts — plus optional automatic sync to Google Sheets for shared recaps.

approach.title: Signature-ready exports
approach.text: PDF with evidence photos embedded, or Excel/CSV for further processing. Dashboard, calendar, and daily stats flow from the same data.

en.outcome: A lightweight gaming-HUD-themed app used daily: one data source, three export formats, zero servers. Hosted on GitHub Pages with React 19 + Vite + Tailwind 4.

title: NIU-DASH
tagline: Kakak dari situs ini — dasbor dark cyber untuk 112 proyek, vanilla JS tanpa framework.
problem: 100+ proyek lintas domain — web, AI tools, dotfiles, GovTech — tersebar tanpa satu layar pemantauan. Portofolio butuh peta, bukan daftar panjang yang tak ada yang membaca.

approach.title: Tiga panel, satu pandangan
approach.text: Sidebar navigasi, feed kartu proyek, dan panel detail — pola dasbor productivity klasik yang terbukti enak dipakai.

approach.title: Vanilla sampai tulang
approach.text: HTML/CSS/JS murni, 100% client-side, di-hosting GitHub Pages. Tanpa build step, tanpa framework — bukti bahwa 'ringan' masih mungkin di 2026.

approach.title: Hidup dari data GitHub
approach.text: Statistik GitHub real-time plus halaman ekosistem — dasbor yang selalu segar tanpa backend.

outcome: v2.17 dengan 112 proyek terlacak — dan, tidak kalah penting: menjadi peta konsep yang kelak memicu penerusnya, dasbor yang sedang Anda baca ini.

en.tagline: This site's older sibling — a dark cyber dashboard for 112 projects, vanilla JS, zero frameworks.
en.problem: 100+ projects across domains — web, AI tools, dotfiles, GovTech — scattered without a single monitoring screen. A portfolio needs a map, not a long list nobody reads.

approach.title: Three panels, one view
approach.text: Navigation sidebar, project card feed, and detail panel — the classic productivity-dashboard layout that just works.

approach.title: Vanilla to the bone
approach.text: Pure HTML/CSS/JS, 100% client-side, hosted on GitHub Pages. No build step, no framework — proof that 'lightweight' is still possible in 2026.

approach.title: Alive from GitHub data
approach.text: Real-time GitHub stats plus an ecosystem page — a dashboard that stays fresh with no backend.

en.outcome: v2.17 tracking 112 projects — and, just as importantly: the concept map that later inspired its successor, the site you are reading right now.

title: Niu-OSS-Dashboard
tagline: Situs yang sedang Anda baca — dasbor yang mengaudit dirinya sendiri.
problem: Portofolio developer biasanya berhenti di 'daftar proyek' — tidak ada bukti hidup bahwa sistemnya cepat, jujur soal datanya, dan benar-benar berjalan. Klaim performa tak bisa diverifikasi pengunjung.

approach.title: Statis murni + 3D yang sopan
approach.text: 208 halaman statis tanpa ISR, hero 3D performance-aware yang degrade rapi saat WebGL lemah — pelajaran pahit dari bug hydration #418 yang pernah melumpuhkan produksi.

approach.title: GitOps ala Upptime
approach.text: GitHub Actions mengecek 10 situs ekosistem tiap 15 menit dan meng-commit hasilnya — /status membaca data ter-commit, bisa diaudit siapa saja.

approach.title: Mengaudit dirinya sendiri
approach.text: CSP report-only dengan endpoint laporan, E2E hidrasi 12/12 di CI, API publik v1 (102 endpoint), dan CHANGELOG yang di-render jadi halaman — situs ini membukukan bukti-buktinya sendiri.

outcome: niumination.web.id live: 90 repo teragregasi live dari API GitHub (bukan angka ketikan), kalender kontribusi 12 bulan via GraphQL, uptime yang bisa dicek publik, dan seluruh perjalanan perbaikannya tercatat di CHANGELOG.

en.tagline: The site you are reading right now — a dashboard that audits itself.
en.problem: A developer portfolio usually stops at 'a list of projects' — no living proof that the system is fast, honest about its data, and actually running. Performance claims the visitor cannot verify.

approach.title: Purely static + polite 3D
approach.text: 208 static pages with no ISR, and a performance-aware 3D hero that degrades gracefully on weak WebGL — a hard lesson from the hydration bug #418 that once crippled production.

approach.title: Upptime-style GitOps
approach.text: GitHub Actions checks 10 ecosystem sites every 15 minutes and commits the results — /status reads committed data anyone can audit.

approach.title: Auditing itself
approach.text: Report-only CSP with a reporting endpoint, 12/12 hydration E2E in CI, a public v1 API (102 endpoints), and a CHANGELOG rendered as a page — this site documents its own evidence.

en.outcome: niumination.web.id live: 90 repos aggregated live from the GitHub API (not typed numbers), a full 12-month GraphQL contribution calendar, publicly auditable uptime, and its entire repair journey recorded in the CHANGELOG.
